_note: Inputs each case reads, as git commits, so peers' uncommitted reruns never leak in. model: the winners lane's case name; winners, distribution, generation: commits holding that case's derived files. sept27: all four pins sent by the parent on 2026-09-28 (winners round 2 at 62f1e5a). sept29 (the v4 case adopted on 2026-09-29): all four pins sent by the lead on 2026-09-29 (distribution 492bf32, generation aa1f53b, winners 858f77a, main case 40c4ba7). valuation.py skips a case without a winners pin, and the other scripts stop on an empty pin.
